description: A crescent prism one high, its two top arcs chamfered at 0.1 so that the stripes meet on their own section from the top's contact (-1.7, -0.8485, 1) down to the spine at (-2, 0, 0.9) (the mutual trim, ADR-0084), the cusp vertex gone. Split by the plane z = 0.95, which crosses both stripes and the section edge; the lower side is the result. The section edge is the cone/cone (or torus/torus) section fitted within SECTION_FIT_FRACTION of the linear tolerance, 2.5e-8 (ADR-0042, ADR-0062); where the cut puts a vertex on it that error no longer cancels between the two faces, so the fixture's volume and inertia are held at 5e-9, not the default 1e-9. A 20-digit quadrature of the chamfered height field gives the exact volume, 4.46583786145: Open CASCADE is 3e-10 off it and Arris's body within 4e-9 as Open CASCADE reads Arris's STEP.
